expected_findings.description: When a change is created with a title and then renamed, the live view shows the original name (already printed to stdout) while `imp log` shows the final name after replaying events; this is an inherent limitation of append-only streaming and is acceptable as documented.

This test asserts that exactly one header line is emitted but does not verify which name is displayed in it, making it impossible to detect a stale-name regression in the live path without further test enhancement.

There is no explicit test for the scenario where a change is created unnamed, receives step events, and is never renamed, to verify that no header is ever printed; this scenario is only implicitly covered by the mechanically-guaranteed title guard.
There is no unit test to verify that `_h_change_renamed` correctly ignores a legacy event payload missing the `new_title` key; golden files provide only indirect coverage of this behavior.
